reason: The cited evidence does not support the key premises. E1 describes impurity-driven phase segregation during thermal aging at 700°C, not stress-induced transformation under mechanical loading. E2 reports a ductile fracture mode with dimples in a cold-drawn HEA wire, directly contradicting the claim of brittle fracture. Neither passage provides evidence for stress-induced brittle phase formation at dislocation pile-ups or grain boundaries.
